name: Six-Cycle Median Obstruction
definition: The singleton family consisting of the chordless six-cycle $C_6$.
canonical_form: The unique cycle graph on six vertices; equivalently $Q_3$ with an antipodal vertex pair deleted.
comments: This singleton overlaps the parameterized antipodally punctured hypercube family at dimension three. It is kept atomic because the median basis forbids only this member of that family.
